title: Context source older than its freshness budget
description: A context source (for example a warehouse snapshot older than a recorded payment) is older than its freshness budget when the snapshot is assembled; volatile facts must be refreshed from the authoritative system before they are spoken or acted on.
callerVisible: The caller is not told a stale balance or status; the agent checks the current record or offers a person.
backendEvidence: Snapshot freshness record marks the source stale
Fresh authoritative lookup before the consequential act
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:STALE_SOURCE] owned by WP-24 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: a context source older than its freshness budget (warehouse snapshot older than a payment)

postconditions: A stale volatile fact is never spoken as current
A consequential act waits for a fresh authoritative lookup
The staleness is visible in the snapshot evidence
